authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 242-206 (even side, 1896-1904), 2024-12-11 overcast strip. 242-234: five narrow kinker-1895-painted-band houses (242 and 240 black-painted, 238-234 dark brown), white blocked heads, pediment dormers and two neck gables, under one long curved white-and-blue canopy. 232-212: plain-brick fronts (2 axes per ~4 m), 224 with a white-clad attic storey, 222-212 over the cream Action/Etos shop front with wide arched first-floor shop windows; 214-212 with white blocked heads. 210-206: kinker-1890-brick-arched with white courses and brick dormer towers.
